document.abstract: The design of the first commercial theater television equipment is based on the experience gained from installing and operating earlier developmental equipments in theaters. Designed to augment the standard theater sound equipment, the PT-100 Television Equipment is intended to combine maximum reliability with performance limited only by the quality of the incoming signal.
